SELECT teacher.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT course_arrange.Course_ID)
FROM teacher
JOIN course_arrange ON teacher.Teacher_ID = course_arrange.Teacher_ID
GROUP BY teacher.Name;
FINAL SQL:
SELECT teacher.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT course_arrange.Course_ID)
FROM teacher
JOIN course_arrange ON teacher.Teacher_ID = course_arrange.Teacher_ID
GROUP BY teacher.Name;
